guarantees.detail: The identity string encodes (surah, ayah, position) under a named segmentation scheme, but position is an attribute of the token, not its identity. A token that moves, splits or merges in a later corpus version receives an explicit successor or tombstone in mapping/.

basmala_note: A separated surah-opening basmala is addressed as ayah 0. Al-Fatiha's basmala is verse 1:1 and keeps that identity.
